items.title: AIHOT
items.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
items.summary: AIHOT is a framework for creating a website where users can find industry-specific hot topics and write daily reports. The framework allows users to customize their sources and selection criteria, transforming it into their own industry hotspot station. The GitHub repository for AIHOT is available, but specific sources and selection standards are not provided to avoid disputes and because they are industry-specific. The creator encourages users to adapt the framework to their own needs and standards.

items.title: OpenDots
items.description: Your always-on AI coworkers that move between text, calls, and Slack.
items.summary: OpenDots is an open-source template for persistent AI agents, each with its own computer, available on Web and Mobile. It moves between text, calls, and Slack, and is built with CopilotKit and AG-UI. The project is self-hostable, and the GitHub repository provides a template that can be customized. The YouTube video describes OpenDots as an open-source alternative to OpenAI Dots, featuring a computer for every Dot with a browser, files, and a terminal, real-time voice calls, Slack collaboration, and Spaces and Pages for document work. The official website emphasizes that each Dot has its own role, permissions, and computer, and the work lands as editable pages. The launch brief notes that Acme shipped a hosted agent runtime with tool calling and traces, but no UI layer or human-in-the-loop primitives.

items.title: dots
items.description: Open-source dots for the web: an AI agent with its own browser, one that does not get blocked.
items.summary: Dots is an open-source AI agent with its own browser, designed to not get blocked, created by feder-cr and available on GitHub with 1,931 stars. It is an alternative to the always-on agent feature in ChatGPT, which continues working after the app is closed, running on its own cloud computer and browser. OpenDots is a self-hosted version of this concept, allowing users to deploy AI agents on their own infrastructure.

items.title: yomiyasu
items.description: AI生成の日本語を自然な日本語へ推敲するAgent Skill / Agent Skill for Refining AI-Generated Japanese into Natural Japanese
items.summary: The sources describe "yomiyasu" as an Agent Skill designed to refine AI-generated Japanese into more natural and readable human-like Japanese. It focuses on reconstructing the grammatical structure of sentences to eliminate ambiguity and restore the intended meaning, addressing issues like the lack of a subject or vague metaphors. The skill is praised for its ability to maintain the original tone of the text while removing AI-specific syntax. It is compatible with various AI coding environments like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. However, some users express concerns about the skill's limitations, such as the inability to address overly long texts or the need for human oversight to ensure the final output meets the intended purpose.

items.title: reelmimic
items.description: Show it a video you love. Get a new video in the same style. An AI crew (Claude Code or Codex) plans, builds and reviews it with you.
items.summary: The sources indicate that ReelMimic is a tool that allows users to generate new videos in the same style as a video they love by showing it a preferred video. It mentions an AI crew (Claude Code or Codex) that plans, builds, and reviews the video with the user. However, the sources do not provide specific details about the functionality or features of ReelMimic beyond this general description. The comparison with SkillsLLM highlights community interest indicators like GitHub stars and forks but does not settle which tool is objectively better.

items.title: answer-me-with-html
items.description: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
items.summary: Answer me with HTML is an open-source AI agent skill for coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT, created by QingYunA. It generates a one-page HTML document to present complex answers in a readable format. The skill is hosted on GitHub with 285 stars and 27 forks. It renders answers with a global rule that applies to conclusions, summaries, plans, comparisons, reviews, or explanations, creating HTML pages stored by default in `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/`. The skill aims to reduce token usage and waiting time for complex answers.

items.title: vibe-wise
items.description: A Claude Code plugin that helps you learn how to build while AI writes the code.
items.summary: Vibe-wise is a Claude Code plugin that helps users learn how to build while AI writes the code. It puts learning first and keeps users in control by asking for their approach first, discussing tradeoffs, and explaining unfamiliar concepts before implementing any code. The plugin writes the code only after user confirmation and explains any changes made. It is useful for walking through design and implementation checkpoints, learning unfamiliar stacks, and designing data schemas for apps. The plugin was created to counteract the tendency to generate code without sufficient understanding, ensuring that users think through their design before coding.

items.title: easyread
items.description: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
items.summary: easyread is an open-source AI skill designed to help users read English papers in a comfortable Chinese format. It translates PDF papers locally, provides side-by-side original and translated texts, allows users to ask questions about the text in real-time, and manages references. The tool aims to provide a reading experience similar to reading a well-formatted Chinese book, with accurate translations, proper LaTeX formatting, and interactive question-answering features. This is supported by sources indicating that it offers a precise and fluent translation of English papers into Chinese, maintaining the original layout and readability.

items.title: mcp-extensions
items.description: Build plugins that feel like native, first-class features of ChatGPT.
items.summary: The sources indicate that mcp-extensions is an open-source SDK provided by OpenAI to enable developers to build plugins that integrate seamlessly with the user experience of ChatGPT, making them feel like native, first-class features. The SDK allows plugins to be hooked into key surfaces of the ChatGPT interface, including the sidebar, composer, and file viewers. It also supports sidebar entrypoints, file extension handlers, composer mentions, and rich forms, allowing for a more integrated and native experience within the platform. The GitHub repository for mcp-extensions shows it has 237 stars and is under an Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: RemoveMacAI
items.description: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back. One command, fully reversible.
items.summary: To turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and reclaim its disk space with one command, use the `removemacai` command from the GitHub repository. This command is fully reversible and utilizes a configuration profile to apply Apple's restriction keys and force settings without modifying files under `/System`. To revert, use the `removemacai revert` command. The GitHub repository also provides commands like `removemacai status` to check the current state and `removemacai off --keep` to leave certain features on. The YouTube video and AppleInsider forum provide additional methods involving terminal commands and enabling Low Data Mode, but these do not offer a single command solution.

items.title: open-dot
items.description: Open-source personal AI agents that work on their own, on their own computers. Mac app, OpenAI + Composio.
items.summary: Open Dot is an open-source, self-hosted alternative to the always-on personal AI agents called Dots launched by OpenAI on September 29, 2026. It is a Mac app that runs always-on personal AI agents on your own computer, providing each agent its own logged-in browser and connecting to various apps via Composio. Open Dot is roughly a tenth of the cost of Dots and is built on Composio. It is the open-source answer to the same idea, running on your Mac, on the models you choose, using your own OpenAI key or open models through OpenRouter.

items.title: oil-ui
items.description: 把 AI 的 UI 设计能力推到极限。
items.summary: The sources indicate that oil-ui aims to push the limits of AI's UI design capabilities by providing a structured, iterative design process that starts with a silent code scan and moves through phases of listening, style family selection, visual choices, full preview, and finally outputting design specifications. It emphasizes not imposing a single style but offering equal options based on user input and preferences. The tool supports visualization templates for comparing and full design systems across various UI types, and it is designed to be adaptable across different tools and frameworks. The sources also highlight the importance of precise prompts and structured thinking in guiding AI for effective UI/UX design, suggesting that while AI can significantly speed up the design process, the designer's role in defining the parameters and verifying the technical feasibility remains crucial.

items.title: whirl

items.summary: The sources mention several AI chat apps, including Sybill, which is noted for B2B sales and deal intelligence, and Anuma, which offers a private AI with a user-owned encrypted memory that carries context across multiple leading models. The sources also highlight the versatility of general-purpose AI chat apps like ChatGPT, which has evolved into a multimodal engine capable of real-time voice, vision, and deep logical reasoning. While specific details about "whirl" are not provided, the sources do emphasize the importance of context and memory in enhancing the functionality of AI chat apps.

items.description: Eleven free Claude skills that clone any app: reverse-engineer it, rebuild it, test it for bugs, then fix what its users hate. Free, MIT.

items.title: strands-decider
items.description: A small, fast decision model, or system one model, for agentic workflows. Pick between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision.
items.summary: Strands Decider is a small, fast decision model, or "system one" model, for agentic workflows. It picks between options or rates on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision. The model uses a pretrained decoder LLM torso (Qwen3.5-2B-Base) with a small pointer head of about a million parameters, adapted with a rank-16 LoRA adapter, and runs locally in fp32. It is an Apache-2.0 decision model from AWS Strands Labs, performing in about 115 ms on an RTX 3090.

items.title: EvoVLM
items.description: Evolving Multimodal Inference Programs: LLM-guided evolutionary search for accurate and efficient vision-language inference.
items.summary: The sources describe various techniques and models for efficient inference in large vision-language models (LVLMs), including dynamic visual token compression, adaptive token reduction, and lightweight modality-specific compressors. They highlight the role of the LLM backbone in the inference process and the importance of efficient vision-language projectors. The sources also mention SmolVLM as an example of a compact vision-language model for resource-constrained environments, employing aggressive token compression techniques. However, they do not provide specific details about "EvoVLM Evolving Multimodal Inference Programs: LLM-guided evolutionary search for accurate and efficient vision-language inference."

items.title: tusk
items.description: A fast, native, keyboard-driven database client for macOS. 20 databases, an AI assistant that shows its work, free and open source.
items.summary: Tusk is a fast, native, keyboard-driven database client for macOS that supports 20 databases and includes an AI assistant that shows its work. It is free and open source, with 202 stars on GitHub. The app is designed to be fast and light, running natively without Electron or web views, and it features a command palette and various keyboard shortcuts for efficient navigation. It connects to multiple databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redis, and MongoDB. The GitHub repository also mentions a MIT license, a code of conduct, and a security policy.

items.title: agentcraft
items.summary: AgentCraft is an open-source tool that reimagines AI coding agents through an RTS-style command center, allowing users to manage AI agents in a real-time strategy experience. It installs lightweight hooks into agent CLIs to report session events to a server, rendering them in a browser-based game UI. On GitHub, AgentCraft is described as a Spigot plugin for Minecraft that spawns intelligent NPC agents backed by Claude, capable of autonomous navigation and various tasks. According to Ido Salomon, AgentCraft is designed for agent orchestration, visualizing agents as heroes and buildings to manage multiple AI agents effectively, with features like real-time task management and integration with plugins and skills.

items.title: iCode
items.description: A lightweight, extensible, fully offline development platform and agent/workflow toolkit for the AI era, with an intuitive TUI, easy deployment, and complete control over your data, agents, and workflows.
items.summary: iCode is a terminal-native toolkit for orchestrating AI agents and multi-step generative workflows with local control over models, tools, memory, and files. It provides model profiles, agents, and prefix-driven controls, along with shell access and execution telemetry inside the TUI. It also offers review, rollback, and offline documentation features. The platform is aimed at developers and workflow architects who prefer keyboard-driven agent configuration and visibility into execution. However, it does not supply a built-in model, requiring users to connect a local or remote endpoint and manage the resulting data and compliance choices.

items.title: SCM
items.description: Deep AI search for every photo and every frame of video in any folder on macOS
items.summary: SCM, or Screen Memories, is a macOS app that allows users to search their local photo and video libraries using plain-language descriptions, with all AI inference running on-device and no cloud uploads. The app uses a local vision model to understand what is in images and video frames. It segments videos into scenes, embeds each scene's midpoint frame, and scores every segment against the query. SCM targets folders, external-drive archives, screenshots, project exports, and other collections that do not fit neatly inside Photos. The app describes five search modes: Files mode retrieves complete photos or videos by visual meaning, Scenes mode targets moments within videos, OCR mode finds visible words, while Dialogue mode searches transcripts. An optional local language model answers questions using the text already extracted from the library.

items.title: bootloops
items.description: BootLoops 1.0: certified computational tools and house engines for exact and high-precision physics and quantitative science, built to be driven by LLM agents. MIT; docs CC BY 4.0.
items.summary: BootLoops 1.0, released on October 1, 2026, is an open-source toolkit created by Harvard physicist Matthew D. Schwartz to bridge the gap between large language models and scientific research. The project, which began in December 2025, utilizes the Python programming language to generate precise scripts for complex scientific calculations. The repository for BootLoops 1.0 carries a single commit and is licensed under the MIT License, with prose and figures under CC BY 4.0. Schwartz and 19 co-authors produced 36 manuscripts across 18 fields, emphasizing the importance of human oversight and verification in AI-assisted scientific research.

items.title: claude-code-pro-course
items.description: Claude Code PRO — полный курс и гайд на русском: CLAUDE.md, settings, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, плагины, CI. 8 лабораторных, библиотека промптов и готовый starter-kit. Здесь бесплатные курсы  по chatgpt -
items.summary: The sources describe "Claude Code PRO" as a comprehensive course and guide in Russian, covering CLAUDE.md, settings, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, plugins, CI, with 8 labs, a prompt library, and a starter kit. It includes 12 modules with theory and examples, 8 labs for practical tasks, a starter kit with 8 skills, 5 subagents, 4 hooks, and a prompt library for 13 task types. The course is useful for installing the starter kit, setting up CLAUDE.md, and automating reviews and tests through labs. It aims to help developers advance beyond basic AI tool usage and become proficient in using it as a development partner.

items.title: dioramas
items.description: A free, open-source framework for cinematic, interactive 3D websites with AI-generated assets (Nano Banana 2 + Meshy 7.1 on fal). 20 example sites.
items.summary: Dioramas is a free, open-source framework for creating cinematic, interactive 3D websites with AI-generated assets. It is designed to build landing pages where the 3D scene itself is the page, featuring hyper-detailed objects, real lighting, a choreographed camera, and one interaction you can touch. The framework ships with 20 complete example sites built with it, including projects like Atlas of Drifting Isles, Lithos, Artemis, The Keeper, Kōen, Nocturne, Nightshift Motor Co., and Aurel Horologie. Everything is free, with no paid tier, account, or CLI to install. The project was launched on September 30, 2026.

items.summary: The sources mention an IMEI repair tool that works on any device, including iOS and Android, addressing issues like IMEI blacklist, null IMEI, and blacklisted IMEI. It also mentions that Chimera Tool provides customer support in multiple languages and is available from 08h to 16h GMT on working days. items.title: academic-deai
items.description: Model-agnostic Chinese and English academic editing for the latest models across Agent platforms. Reduce formulaic prose while preserving evidence and author voice.
items.summary: The sources indicate that there isn't a single best AI model for academic writing in 2026, as different tasks require different capabilities. For literature reviews, Paperguide (Literature Review Agent) is recommended, while Paperguide AI Paper Writer excels in methodology sections. Yomu AI is best for academic essays, and Paperpal is preferred for journal manuscript editing. Jenni AI offers interactive autocomplete for drafting, but it's not designed for literature discovery or reference management. Writefull focuses on sentence-level language edits and academic phrasing, particularly for non-native English writers. It's advised to use these tools for local editing rather than producing finished prose, as full rewrites can alter the meaning and obscure the author's voice.

items.title: pipod
items.description: pi pod: run pi coding-agent sessions in remote sandboxes, on a server you run yourself
items.summary: Pi pod runs sessions of the pi coding agent in isolated sandboxes ("pods") on a server you run, so an agent can work on a repo without touching your machine. To run Pi in an isolated environment, you can use a Dockerfile to build a container image and then run it with Docker. The Dockerfile includes installing necessary dependencies and setting up the Pi coding agent. To start Pi, you run a Docker container with environment variables and volume mounts to access your working folder and keep Pi settings and sessions between runs. You can also use Kubernetes to manage Pi in a sandbox environment, where you create a pod named pi-code-agent and interact with Pi through the terminal TUI.

items.title: project-manager-skill
items.description: A self-contained project management skill for ChatGPT: milestones, implementation coordination, exact-build QA, and project records.
items.summary: The GitHub repository finna/project-manager-skill offers a self-contained project management skill for managing software, app, and game projects from an agreed vision through milestones, implementation handoffs, testing of exact builds, and fix-and-retest loops. It keeps progress, decisions, screenshots, and versioned QA evidence in a private project Space. However, it does not provide tools, credentials, permissions, or unattended execution. Execution requires connected, authorized tools for the repository, implementation thread, build/runtime, and testing. The Asana resource emphasizes the importance of project timelines, task management, and modern project management tools, while the GoodDay blog highlights the use of project management tools like ChatGPT for planning, executing, and managing projects, along with features for team collaboration, product management, and resource management.

items.title: Papermorph

items.summary: Papermorph is an AI skill that transforms books into animated, narrated, interactive web experiences. The skill is currently limited to Opus 5.5, without image models, multilingual support, or background music. Planned future features include image models and storyboarding for interactive picture books and humanities documentaries. The skill is available on GitHub with 83 stars and 5 forks as of today.

It operates through a browser interface where users describe the video they want, and an AI agent builds it as a real Remotion project. The tool is a macOS app where the coding agent makes the video as a real Remotion project owned by the user, not a rented file. It is built with technologies like Tauri, Next.js, React, and Remotion, and is released under the MIT License. The sources do not provide specific details about pricing or installation beyond what is mentioned.

items.title: text-humanizer

items.summary: The sources indicate that Humaniser is designed to bypass popular AI detection tools including GPTZero, Turnitin, Originality.AI, Copyleaks, Winston AI, and others with a very high success rate, claiming a 99.8% success rate in bypassing GPTZero, Turnitin, and other AI detectors. It supports over 45 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, and Arabic. The tool is trusted by students, content creators, writers, and business professionals globally. The YouTube review also highlights that Rephrasy AI, another tool, can significantly lower AI detection scores, achieving 0% detection in tests against raw AI generated text. The Yahoo Finance article mentions that Humanizer AI's rewriting engine rephrases and restructures AI-generated sentences to reduce detectable patterns while preserving the original meaning, and it has surpassed 6 million users.

items.title: RSIGame
items.description: RSIGame: Autonomous agentic game development with recursive self-improvement
items.summary: RSIGame is an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. It organizes development into complementary local and global loops. The local loop explores, diagnoses, and improves the game, while the global loop tracks overall quality and detects regression. RSIGame internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training, consistently improving game quality across various tasks and engines. Notably, it enables Qwen3.8-27B to achieve higher scores on Godot and Phaser compared to GPT-5.5, while reducing generation tokens by 11 times.

items.title: qiaomu-clipper
items.description: 乔木剪藏：剪藏网页到 Obsidian，阅读、编辑，并向 AI 提问 | Clip the web to Obsidian, then read, edit and chat with AI about it.
items.summary: The sources indicate that the Obsidian Web Clipper is designed to integrate seamlessly with the Obsidian ecosystem, creating well-formatted vault notes with proper frontmatter and templates. It is free, open source, and emphasizes privacy by storing all clipped content locally in your Obsidian vault. Web2MD, on the other hand, optimizes for AI input quality by aggressively stripping noise, preserving semantic structure, and providing direct paths to AI tools. Web2MD is free for up to 3 conversions per day, with Pro users getting unlimited conversions, direct Obsidian vault export, batch processing, and one-click AI integration. The choice between the two depends on whether you prioritize deep Obsidian integration or AI research capabilities.

items.description: A Codex plugin for a better mobile development experience for android and iOS
items.summary: The Mobile Dev plugin for Codex supports live performance monitoring on both Android and iOS with CPU, memory, FPS tracking, and before/after performance comparisons. It aggregates native and JavaScript logs, including iOS unified logs, Android logcat, and Metro console, and provides live performance monitoring with CPU, memory, FPS tracking, and before/after comparisons.

items.summary: SystemCare Pro optimizes desktop utility configuration by providing a dedicated AI-driven platform that meticulously monitors and streamlines routine system maintenance tasks. It offers one-click and AI-driven optimization, deep junk-file and registry cleaning, and a clean, intuitive interface suitable for non-technical users. The Pro version, priced at $29.99 per year for 1 PC (covering up to 3 PCs), includes real-time protection, deep optimization, and 24/7 support. It also features AI-based scanning technology, deep registry cleaning with AI mode, automatic RAM cleaning, and Internet Booster to speed up the Internet. However, some users report slow support response and upsell ads in the Pro version.
